SELECT
  title,
  AI.GENERATE_DOUBLE(
    ("Rate the sentiment of this article title on a scale of 0 to 1, where 1 is very positive: ", title)
  ).result AS sentiment_score
FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext`
LIMIT 3
